title: No cap on Newsgroups group count — log-append DoS
description: validate_article_ingress (core/src/validation.rs:133) checks that newsgroups is non-empty but imposes no upper bound on h.newsgroups.len(). An article with 10,000 group names passes all validation. In the transit pipeline this causes 10,000 separate log appends per article — a DoS multiplier any peer can exploit by crossposting to fabricated group names. In the reader, 10,000 GroupName::new + allowed_groups lookups run per POST. Fix: add a check like if h.newsgroups.len() > MAX_NEWSGROUPS { return Err(ValidationError::TooManyNewsgroups(...)) } with a sensible constant (e.g. 100).
